decisions: Wrote page_subtitle and page_info as new gettext_lazy strings on TeamView since the brief specified the mechanism (page_subtitle / page_info + page_info_actions) but not exact wording; kept each to one or two plain sentences per the acceptance criteria's own phrasing ('who runs the portal and what the roles mean' / 'what a portal role is and how it differs from a contribution role').

No template changes were needed for the title, lead paragraph, or info dialog: page_view.html's <c-page.title :attrs="page"> already spreads PageMixin's full page context dict (title, subtitle, info, info_actions) onto django-mvp's title component, which draws the info icon and its modal itself. Only the view's class attributes changed.

Discovered the worktree's poetry virtualenv had been recreated on Python 3.14 (site default), not the pinned 3.13 the brief described, and pytest couldn't even collect (`ImportError: cannot import name 'find_loader' from 'pkgutil'`, removed in 3.12+, used by an installed dependency). Ran `poetry env use /home/sam/.local/bin/python3.13` then `poetry install --sync` inside this worktree only, touching no dependency pin or the lock file (confirmed via `git status` before/after - poetry.lock and pyproject.toml are unchanged). This did not touch any other worktree or the running dev server on port 8000.

The two pre-existing test_menus.py assertions (test_second_child_is_user_guide, test_third_child_is_admin_guide) pinned the misspelled 'faridm.org' URL as expected behaviour. Per the brief's own prior_decisions instructing the fix in this same file, and craft-tdd's defect-fix loop (write/observe the failing assertion for the corrected URL, then fix the source), I updated those two literal strings from faridm.org to fairdm.org rather than leaving a test that asserts a bug is correct behaviour. This is the one case in this run where a pre-existing test's assertion text changed; no test was weakened, skipped, or had its coverage reduced - it now asserts the corrected value the brief explicitly asked for.
notes: All 8 pre-existing tests in tests/test_contrib/test_contributors/test_views/test_team.py pass unmodified; 4 new tests were added to the same class covering the title, lead paragraph, info dialog + its documentation action, and the responsive grid classes actually emitted into the markup. Who is listed, role order, and the two-query access pattern (get_roles) were not touched. The grid_config change (cols=1, md=2, lg=4, gap=4) is presentation-only, as scoped; the brief notes the cards themselves may look wrong in a four-column track and that is not this task's concern. The environment's Python version drift (3.14 instead of the pinned 3.13) is worth flagging to the orchestrator in case other 017-* worktrees hit the same pkgutil import failure - it was a per-worktree poetry virtualenv cache issue, resolved locally, no shared files changed.
